content.key_idea: DIP's pipeline schedule searcher decomposes the intractable ILP scheduling problem into a three-phase heuristic loop: MCTS-based segment reordering, dual-queue greedy stage interleaving across pipeline ranks, and per-layer memory optimization that removes reserved-but-unused memory.
content.reading_order: Top: per-microbatch computation graphs feed MCTS (①) to produce reordered pipeline segments; middle: segments are interleaved across pipeline ranks PP0-PP2 (②); bottom: two memory-over-time charts show the before/after effect of per-layer memory optimization (③), which removes the reserved-but-unused region.

summary: This figure details the internal workflow of DIP's pipeline schedule searcher, which decomposes an intractable monolithic ILP scheduling problem into a three-phase heuristic loop. First, per-microbatch computation graphs (colored by Modality 1, Modality 2, and Backbone Model, with forward/backward chunks linked by red data-dependency arrows) are fed into a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) that reorders pipeline segments. Second, a dual-queue greedy algorithm interleaves the resulting segments' forward and backward stages across pipeline-parallel ranks PP0-PP2 to minimize bubbles. Third, per-layer memory optimization selects memory-saving strategies (e.g., activation checkpointing and offloading), shown as a before/after memory-over-time chart pair where a pink 'reserved but not used' region is eliminated in favor of memory that is actively 'in use'. Circled numbers ①-③ mark the three phases, and the whole loop is described as highly parallelizable across CPU threads.
summary_zh: 该图展示DIP流水线调度搜索器的内部工作流程：①用蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)对按模态1、模态2、骨干模型着色的微批计算图进行分段重排；②贪心算法将分段的前向/反向阶段交织排布到PP0~PP2各流水线并行等级；③逐层内存优化消除'预留未用'的内存区域，图表对比优化前后内存占用随时间的变化。
